stop.command: bash "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")")/templates/scripts/hooks_stops.sh" stop "Claude Code 会话即将结束，请确认是否继续"
stop.reason: User confirmation required before stopping session

preCompact.command: bash "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")")/templates/scripts/user_confirmation.sh" --dialog compact "Claude Code 压缩操作" "即将进行压缩操作，请确认是否继续"

postToolUse.Write: bash "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")")/templates/scripts/user_confirmation.sh" --subtitle "文件修改" custom "文件修改提醒" "文件已修改，请确认更改是否正确"
